subject: Intro: HelenHealth AWS co-sell intake — initial plan & scheduling
messages:
From: Ravi Singh <ravi.singh@amazon.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Introduction — HelenHealth (AWS co-sell lead)

Hi Mateo / Lauren —

Quick intro: Jenny Park is the procurement lead at HelenHealth; they’re evaluating marketplace procurement + co-sell for an LLM deployment pilot. I’m connecting you to run a short intake and draft a mutual action plan. HelenHealth is particularly focused on latency/region requirements and procurement timelines (30–45 days).

Suggested immediate next steps:
- 30–40m joint intro with HelenHealth + AWS SA to align scope and procurement cadence
- Draft a one-page mutual action plan (MA) to lock milestones (procurement, trial, production)
- Surface any regulatory questions early (data residency, logging)

I’ve attached the standard MA template we use for AWS handshakes. Ravi

Attachments: MA-Template.xlsx (spreadsheet — MA milestones)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Ravi Singh <ravi.singh@amazon.com>, Jenny Park <jenny.park@helenhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-22T09:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Introduction — HelenHealth (AWS co-sell lead)

Thanks Ravi — hi Jenny, great to meet you via email.

Happy to run the intake. Proposed agenda for a 30m call:
1) 10m — HelenHealth goals + current infra constraints (latency, region, security)
2) 10m — Redwood capabilities + recommended listing + co-sell flow
3) 5m — procurement runway / licensing model options
4) 5m — next steps & owner assignment (MA owner / technical owner)

I’m available Tue/Wed 11:00–13:00 PT or Thu 09:00–12:00 PT. If none of those work, please propose two times and we’ll loop in an AWS SA.

Action items: I’ll draft an initial MA in the shared Drive once we confirm time and scope.

—Mateo

Hi Mateo — thanks for the quick reply and agenda. Wed 11:30 PT works best for our team (we have a standing procurement sync at 11:00 and should be free by 11:30).

Short context for the call:
- Pilot scope: conversational triage for provider intake; expected pilot users ~100/day, ramping to 1k/day over 6 months.
- Key constraints: must be provisioned in us-west-2; we need SOC2 evidence and a brief on log retention/archiving options.
- Procurement: standard PO + 30–45 day approval cycle; procurement@helenhealth.com will join for cadence.

Please include an initial estimate for trial cost and the MA milestones in the meeting notes. See you Wed 11:30 PT.
